name: bringup-c2-calibration
about: Bring-up matrix row calibration (C2): full six-calibration boot on the calibration-token hi5622_wifi driver with h2d_send_budget=8. ctx_create type 1 -> txq_sync72 -> 6x cfg_cal (3502..3507); gates every consumption, every 298 B g1 id3 answer (relative catalogue delta + last_total), the h2d_status counters and the final golden page.

steps.name: note
steps.about: C2: the canonical six-calibration boot on the calibration-token driver - ONE ctx_create type 1, ONE txq_sync72, then the six vendor calibration alg set_* events (cfg ids 3502/3503/3504/3505/3506/3507), one message per idea, budget 8. Expected: every message consumed in 0 polls, six 298 B g1 id3 config-syn answers, mask stays 0 and the boot page stays golden.

steps.name: baseline
steps.about: D2H catalogue before the first H2D message (delta baseline for the six responses)

steps.name: pre-pack
steps.about: pre-create state: ctx+0x190 = 0 (no context), mask = 0, staging = 0/unmodified

steps.name: ctx-create-t1
steps.about: ONE context-create H2D: g0 id1 key 0x64, data[0]=type 1 (the allocating variant; the 2026-11-25 validated lap)

steps.name: post-create
steps.about: the create allocated the context: ctx+0x190 != 0, V+0x10 = 0x64 and V+0x14 = 3 (the two 2026-11-25 validated signatures)

steps.name: txq-sync72
steps.about: ONE TXQ config sync H2D (g0 id1 cmd 0xd8, 72-byte node); requires the allocated context from ctx-create-t1

steps.name: post-txq
steps.about: the TXQ handler ran clean: no exception mask bit and no staged exception frame

steps.name: cal-3502
steps.about: calibration alg set_* #1: HCC g0 id2 key 0x0101, cfg id 3502 (298 B frame); ONE message per idea, never repeated on the same boot

steps.name: settle-3502
steps.about: bounded wait for the firmware answer to reach the direct reader

steps.name: resp-3502

expect_entries.about: the firmware's config-syn answer: g1 id3, 298 B (0x12A) total, one per calibration message

steps.about: after calibration #1 the catalogue must show at least 1 more g1 id3 frames, the newest being 298 B
